class.name: FoxDashManager
class.brief_description: Component that manages the math, memory, and rules for a dash ability.
class.description: Acts as a specialized stopwatch and data container, tracking cooldowns and duration without directly applying physics.

method.name: request
method.description: Registers a request from the player or AI controller to perform a dash.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancels a pending dash request manually.

method.name: has_request
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a dash has been requested but not yet consumed.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the dash cooldown timer has fully elapsed.

method.name: consume
method.description: Clears the current dash request, records the time, and alerts external systems.

members.member: The burst speed applied to the character during the dash, in meters per second.
The total time the dash state remains active, in seconds.
The required wait time before another dash can be requested, in seconds.

signal.name: consumed
signal.description: Emitted when a dash request is validated and consumed with [method consume].

signal.name: requested
signal.description: Emitted when a dash is requested with [method request].

signal.name: request_cancelled
signal.description: Emitted when a pending dash is cancelled with [method cancel].
